description: A 10.04-carat Fancy Yellow radiant in yellow gold double-claw prongs, flanked by two white half-moon diamonds and a micro-pavé diamond band. Handcrafted in Los Angeles. Ref C0878.
editorial: A 10.04-carat Fancy Yellow radiant in yellow gold double-claw prongs, flanked by two white half-moon diamonds and a micro-pavé diamond band. The radiant cut was built to hold colour across a faceted face — more facets than a round, more surface contact than an emerald, a deeper pavilion than either. At ten carats, the question isn't whether the colour is there. It's whether the setting serves it. Double-claw prongs keep the seat open. Half-moon sides follow the corner geometry of the radiant exactly. The pavé band anchors the piece to the finger.
